signals.name: Alphabet
signals.label: Multi-member Congress buy + retail chatter
signals.detail: At least two directly-verified Congress members bought GOOG in 2026 (Cleo Fields, Sep 14; John Fetterman, Mar 30), with aggregator reporting pointing to additional buyers. Alphabet also appeared among retail traders' most-discussed names in Benzinga's roundup of X/Reddit chatter for the week of Sept 28-Oct 2, 2026.
signals.takeaway: Worth watching whether this Congress-plus-retail overlap in Alphabet persists into Q4 earnings.

signals.name: Intel
signals.label: Congress heavy-buying + Reddit sentiment
signals.detail: 27 members of Congress have disclosed roughly 100 INTC trades since Trump's inauguration, led by Marjorie Taylor Greene, Rob Bresnahan and Kevin Hern, plus Nancy Pelosi's large 2026 buys; GOP members' aggregate portfolio weight in Intel has reportedly risen to ~7.7%. Separately, INTC logged 41 WallStreetBets mentions in a recent 24-hour window with 59% positive sentiment.
signals.takeaway: The overlap between a GOP-side 'Trump trade' thesis in Congress and retail bullishness on Reddit is worth keeping on the radar.

signals.name: Bloom Energy
signals.label: Congress buy + hedge-fund 13F accumulation
signals.detail: Pelosi's July 2026 BE purchase (disclosed Aug 21) coincided with reported 13F positioning from Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness Fund and Whale Rock Capital, plus BE's addition to the S&P 500 on Sept 21, 2026.
signals.takeaway: A name where congressional disclosure, hedge-fund 13F activity, and an index-inclusion catalyst lined up in the same quarter -- worth tracking for follow-through.

signals.name: SpaceX
signals.label: Bipartisan first-mover Congress buy
signals.detail: Reps. Dan Meuser (R) and Gil Cisneros (D) were the first two disclosed congressional buyers of SpaceX stock, both within days of the company's June 2026 IPO, and both sit on committees with oversight touching SpaceX/Pentagon contracts.
signals.takeaway: A small but bipartisan cluster of insider-adjacent buying right after an IPO is worth monitoring independent of either member's individual trade.

signals.name: Microsoft
signals.label: Broad bipartisan Congress accumulation
signals.detail: 22 members of Congress have disclosed roughly 50 MSFT trades (27 buys vs 23 sells) over the recent period, with named buyers including Gil Cisneros, Maria Elvira Salazar, Mark Warner, Josh Gottheimer, John Fetterman and Cleo Fields.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether this broad, cross-party accumulation in Microsoft continues as AI-infrastructure spending headlines keep rolling in.

signals.name: Amkor Technology
signals.label: Congress buy + institutional pickup
signals.detail: Sen. Markwayne Mullin bought AMKR twice in early 2026 (Jan 5, Feb 4); Bank of America separately opened a new ~$22.9M AMKR position in Q2 2026 amid a chip advanced-packaging growth narrative. Shares are up roughly 60% since Mullin's buys.
signals.takeaway: A semiconductor-packaging name where a senator's early buy, subsequent institutional accumulation, and an AI-driven packaging demand story have pointed the same direction -- worth a look.

congress.rationale: Large Bloom Energy buy (shares plus deep-dated $100-strike calls) landed just ahead of BE's S&P 500 inclusion and an AI-power-demand rally -- notable given Pelosi's history of well-timed, outsized options trades.
congress.deepDive: Disclosed August 21, 2026 for a July 24 transaction; alongside the BE buy, Pelosi also added to Intel. BE shares rose roughly 44% in the weeks after disclosure, helped by a $2.65B AEP power deal, an Oracle AI-data-center tie-up, and the stock's September 21, 2026 addition to the S&P 500.

congress.rationale: One of several same-week tech buys (also AAPL, MSFT, NFLX) by a freshman member with no obvious committee tie to tech; fits a broader bipartisan pattern of lawmakers accumulating mega-cap AI names this year.
congress.deepDive: Disclosed October 1, 2026 for a trade executed through a Morgan Stanley-E*TRADE account; part of a buying spree across Apple, Microsoft and Netflix in the same two-week window.

congress.rationale: Bought Amgen and Home Depot the same day he sold Marathon Petroleum -- a same-day rotation out of energy into healthcare/consumer that lines up with the fall pullback in refining margins.
congress.deepDive: Executed September 22, 2026 through a Schwab joint brokerage account; the Amgen buy ran through a 401(k), each in the smallest STOCK Act bracket.

congress.rationale: Taylor has previously drawn scrutiny for selling oil refiners during geopolitical spikes; this exit continues a recurring pattern of trimming energy exposure rather than a one-off call.
congress.deepDive: Disclosed October 1-3, 2026 through the David Taylor Trust. Ohio outlet Signal Ohio has separately reported he sold refiners during the Iran-conflict oil spike earlier this year.

congress.rationale: Trimmed JPM the same day he sold Visa, Analog Devices, Nvidia, Lam Research, Amgen and Lowe's -- looks like a broad 10b5-1 portfolio rebalance rather than a single-name signal.
congress.deepDive: Executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 plan on September 4, 2026. Post-sale, Whitehouse still directly held 71,047 JPM shares (~$25.1M), so this was a partial trim, not an exit.

congress.rationale: McConnell's third disclosed Wells Fargo buy of 2026 (after March and July) -- an unusual steady drip-buy in a single regional bank for a senator with no banking-committee seat.
congress.deepDive: Each of the three 2026 WFC buys has fallen in the same $15,001-$50,000 bracket.

congress.amount: ~$753,005-$1,545,000 (aggregated across several MSFT options line items)
congress.rationale: Gottheimer is one of Congress's most active options traders and MSFT is his most-traded name; this filing is large even by his standards and landed as the stock pushed toward new highs.
congress.deepDive: The filing bundled several MSFT call-option buys/sells across strikes. Gottheimer has logged roughly 1,640 total trades concentrated in MSFT, TSLA, AAPL, LLY and NVDA.

congress.rationale: Bought through a dependent child's account alongside AMZN, MSFT and MU -- notable mainly because Fetterman has backed a congressional stock-trading ban while his household kept trading.
congress.deepDive: Included here mainly for the cross-member Alphabet-buying pattern (see signals); Fetterman's office has separately cited an unrelated STOCK Act timeliness lapse this year.

congress.date: 2026-06-25 (transaction date; disclosed 2026-08-07, well past the 45-day STOCK Act deadline)
congress.rationale: One of 22 trades Rulli disclosed months late, across a basket of mega-caps (AAPL, AMZN, META, GOOGL, MSFT, NVDA, MU, PLTR) -- a clear compliance lapse worth flagging for the disclosure lag alone.
congress.deepDive: Rulli's August 2026 catch-up filing covered 32 trades dating to November 2024; sources differ on the full late batch's aggregate value ($330K-$480K depending on bracket-midpoint math).

congress.rationale: Bought via a dependent child's account days after SpaceX's $75B IPO; Meuser chairs a subcommittee with oversight touching SpaceX, making the timing a clear conflict-of-interest flag -- reportedly his first individual-stock buy in years.
congress.deepDive: Meuser and Gil Cisneros were the only two lawmakers known to buy SpaceX stock immediately post-IPO, per Spotlight PA reporting on the oversight conflict.

congress.rationale: A repeat buy (after a January 5 purchase) in an under-the-radar semiconductor packaging name; shares are up roughly 60% since, aided by a later Nvidia-linked advanced-packaging growth narrative.
congress.deepDive: This was Mullin's second AMKR buy within a month. AMKR has also seen fresh institutional buying this year, including a new Bank of America position (~265,073 shares, ~$22.9M) initiated in Q2 2026.

congress.rationale: Wyden is the Senate Finance Committee's ranking Democrat and a vocal advocate for banning congressional stock trading; disclosing this merger-related share exchange 465 days late -- the most extreme lag in this batch -- undercuts his own reform message, even though his office frames it as non-discretionary.
congress.deepDive: An automatic share exchange from the Amcor-Berry Global merger, held in his wife's account. His office said the Senate Ethics Committee assessed no penalty, calling it an oversight caught while preparing his annual disclosure.

congress.rationale: Cisneros sits on House Armed Services, which oversees Pentagon/Space Force contracts SpaceX depends on; buying days after the IPO drew immediate bipartisan conflict-of-interest scrutiny alongside Meuser's purchase.
congress.deepDive: Cisneros told CNBC he doesn't manage day-to-day trading of his portfolio. Together with Meuser, this marked the first known congressional SpaceX purchases after the company's record $75B IPO.

congress.rationale: Part of a batch of 25 stock-purchase disclosures filed via a third-party manager across two UBS accounts; another data point in Microsoft's status as one of Congress's most broadly-held names across both parties in 2026.
congress.deepDive: Alongside buys of Amgen, Carrier Global and Sherwin-Williams. Capitol Trades separately flagged her same-period defense-stock buys given her Foreign Affairs Committee seat.
